name: EDGEdir camera spike (D6c)
author: Edgemodders
description: A spike for EDGEdir's camera track (D6c): spawns a bare entity with a camera component, cuts the view to it and back to V, moves and turns it while it is on, sets its field of view, tries a second camera and a blend time, and raises V's scene tier. Every call and its time go to the log; what the view does is for the player to say. Not part of EDGEdir's release.
